items.title: Exponential diameter lower bounds for high-precision three-dimensional array scaling
items.author: W. Cole Franks; Philipp Reichenbach
items.source_version: Official complete54-pageCCC2021 publication,2021-07-08; mainTheorem1.1 and complete authorSection3/AppendixE padding proof. Nonexclusive arxivv2 is private transcription aid only.
items.difficulty_reason: The authors construct a sparse three-partite support from a weighted directed graph whose matrix has an exponentially small singular value, control the inradius of the remaining support polytope, and force every high-precision capacity minimizer far from the origin.
